description: Use to estimate selected federal failure-to-file, failure-to-pay, and underpayment amounts from nonidentifying figures. The result is an estimate and does not replace an IRS account transcript.

balance_owed_usd.description: The unpaid tax balance (the tax itself, before penalties and interest).

months_late.description: Whole months past the deadline. The failure-to-file penalty counts any part of a month as a full month.

return_filed.description: Whether you actually FILED the return (even if you did not pay). If false, the larger 5%/month failure-to-file penalty applies. Defaults to false (not filed).

name: estimate_irs_penalty

next_step.description: A single review link appropriate to this server surface.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).

source_url.description: Official IRS or FinCEN authority to review before relying on the result.

title: Estimate IRS penalties and interest
